gaia_source_id: # Curated exceptions to the label merge's mechanical rule (overlay wins on
# disagreement, docs/catalog-driver.md § 4). One row per record per identifier;
# an empty `value` keeps the spine's. `#` in the first column comments a line —
# the header stays the first line, as every committed TSV's does.
# NO ROWS. Nearly every one of today's 137 disagreements is either a real AT-HYG
# cross-ID error the overlay corrects (Izar: AT-HYG's HR 5505 against IV/27A +
# V/50's HR 5506, and ε Boo IS HR 5506) or a resolved close pair whose two
# components the two catalogues letter oppositely — neither is the CDS join being
# wrong, which is the only thing this file is for. The full enumeration with
# dispositions is data/classic-ids/label_flips.tsv.
# Four shapes look like exceptions and are each reached by a rule instead, so
# they do not belong here. Their rules are in
# scripts/catalog/classic-ids/README.md:
#   - an overlay HD routed through a NEIGHBOUR's Tycho entry, which the record's
#     own TYC contradicts through IV/25 — Propus (η Gem) is the case
#     (§ The overlay may not displace the record's own TYC's HD);
#   - a swapped GJ component letter, decided on CNS5's own evidence — Gl 563.2
#     A/B (§ The gl comparison is specificity-aware);
#   - an addition that would make another record's designation ambiguous,
#     withheld mechanically (§ The collision guard);
#   - a Gliese renumbering (Gl 157.1 -> GJ 9140), an identity bridge in
#     data/sid/sameas-overrides.tsv, since both designations name the star.
